name_input: Advance Cork International (Advance Rub Cork International)
product_summary: No public website, catalogue or product page could be located. The DuckDuckGo search tool returned a backend error (connection refused) on every attempt; fallback queries via Bing returned only generic dictionary/automotive results for the word 'advance' and generic 'cork' tourism/material pages, with no hit for 'Advance Cork International' or 'Advance Rub Cork'. IndiaMART product page fetch was blocked (HTTP 429). Therefore the real product list is unknown: no evidence of agglomerated cork sheets/blocks (4504), natural cork articles (4503), cork flooring panels (4504/4418), cork insulation or rubber-cork gasket material. Nothing can be corroborated against a customs line.
comment: HS 450490 = agglomerated cork (with or without binder) and articles of agglomerated cork, other than 4504.10.10 cork waste/crushed-granulated. This is a plausible code for a cork-sheet/block trader or converter, and the name 'Advance Rub Cork' hints at rubber-cork composite sheet (which would still normally sit in 4504 if cork predominates, or 4008 if rubber predominates) — but this is inference from the company name only, NOT a verified product list. Per project rule 3, an HS mismatch is never a rejection ground; here there is no mismatch evidence at all, only absence of evidence, so the company is kept with the declared code unchanged and status cannot_verify. Declared industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) is consistent with cork flooring/insulation but unconfirmed. Trader signs: the words 'International' and the dual trading name suggest a possible importer/distributor rather than a manufacturer — unconfirmed. Product lines possibly missing from the declaration (all 'заявлено, не подтверждено' / unverified): cork flooring tiles, cork underlay, rubber-cork gasket sheet, cork stoppers. No PAN, state, website or catalogue data is public in what I could reach; fields left null rather than invented. Recommend re-run once the search backend is restored, or obtain the company's own catalogue/IndiaMART page directly.
